title: feat(scenarios): the gallery export writes each app as a trial package (listing text, facet, sample data); the check refuses an app with no sample data
body:
Fixes #35132
Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:应用市场画廊导出的每个应用,现在都带上场景卡的中英文标题和简介、业务职能分类,以及卡上的种子数据(作为安装时的示例数据)。画廊检查会拒绝没有示例数据的应用。
- 为什么改:目标是「客户可以从应用市场中下载安装试用」。之前导出的应用装上后是空的,名字是 `Demoasset`,也没有分类。
- 风险与回滚:风险低。只改导出副本和检查,不碰运行时,不碰被评分的构建。回滚就是还原这个 PR。用旧版导出器写出的画廊目录,在下一次刷新重新导出之前,新检查会报 `app-sample-data`;检查只读不写,不会删除任何应用。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/trial-package.ts`(`withSampleData` 对 AI 写的配置做的 AST 拼接,以及四种拒绝情况)→ `src/export/check.ts`(`checkSampleData`)→ `src/export/exporter.ts`(`trialPackageSource` 的调用点)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/export`,预期 4 个文件、132 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The gallery exporter (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/`) now writes each app's `source/` as a package a customer can install and try. It does this after scoring, into the export copy only. The run's own project is never written.

- `objectstack.manifest.json`: `displayName` and `description` are the card's English title and `prompt.short`. The Chinese pair goes under `translations.zh`. `businessFunctions` is the card's own list. The build's other keys are kept.
- `src/sample-data.json`: the card's seed rows as stack `data:` datasets. There is one dataset per object, named `demoCODE_object`, with `externalId: 'id'` and rows as the card states them. A `run.userHandleFields` field is left out, and the app README names it.
- `objectstack.config.ts`: gets one import line and `data: gallerySampleData` as the first property of the default-exported `defineStack({ … })` literal. The edit is a TypeScript AST splice, and every other byte stays as the AI wrote it. Four cases are refused with a located reason, never guessed: there is no such literal, the literal already declares `data:` or spreads a value, a seeded object is missing from the build, or the build already wrote the file.
- `export-gallery --check` has a new finding, `app-sample-data`. It reports a missing `source/src/sample-data.json`, a file that is not a non-empty list of `SeedSchema`-valid datasets each with a record, or a config that does not import it.
- `typescript` moves from devDependencies to dependencies. It was already in the install closure through `@objectstack/lint`. The exporter loads it with a dynamic `import()`, so `export-gallery --check` (`dist/export-check.js`) never loads it.
- Not written, per the seat's re-split on the card: `installModes`, `solutionType: 'template'`, and the check's installModes refusal. These moved to #35266, which is blocked by #35157. With `installModes: ['unmanaged']`, `defineStack` refuses an app carrying `plugins` or `capability` items (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts:2843`).

## Tests

All at head `30a918ccf0`.

- `test/export/exporter.test.ts` has a new top-level describe, "the trial package". It pins the manifest's four keys with the build's keys kept. It pins the sample data: namespaced, keyed on `id`, crm's `account.owner` left out. It pins the config edit: one import, `data` first, and the rest byte-identical to the authored file. It checks that the run's project is untouched and that the README line is present. It also covers a scaffold-shaped config, a config with no import line, six refused config shapes, three refused sources, one refusal through `exportGallery` (no app directory written), and `sampleDataOf` over every card in the library.
- `test/export/check.test.ts`: the exporter's own output is still clean. There are four `app-sample-data` cases, and the code roster is updated.

<details><summary>Readings: package suite, typecheck, ablations</summary>

- `os-verify-lock … vitest run --maxWorkers=2` (whole `@objectstack/scenarios` suite): `Test Files 40 passed (40)`, `Tests 1199 passed (1199)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck`: exit 0.
- Ablation 1: `ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the `checkSampleData(dir, app, add);` call (anchor 1 → 0, blob 0d9fd6d4 → 0c9d9b17). Result: `Tests 4 failed | 37 passed (41)`, which is exactly the four sample-data cases. Restored blob 0d9fd6d4 equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Ablation 2: the `trialPackageSource` call was replaced with the authored files as they are (blob 7b14425e → 16986a84). Result: `Tests 32 failed | 67 passed (99)` across exporter and check suites. Among them are the layout test, the trial-package export test and the `data:` refusal export test; the check's clean tree goes red, as do the other cases that copy it. Restored blob 7b14425e equals HEAD.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Measured, as the seat asked: the exported source still passes `objectstack validate` with the new keys, on a managed stack. A probe project used the blank scaffold's `objectstack.config.ts` verbatim (connector plugins included), the recorded `travel_expense` build's 7 objects, and `trialPackageSource` output with 757 rows. `os validate` printed `✓ Validation passed`, exit 0. The control project without the trial edits also exited 0. A negative leg, with one dataset renamed to `demotravel_nope`, exited 1 with `Seed data references object 'demotravel_nope' which is not defined in objects.`, so the validator reads the imported JSON. The probe dropped the three `state_machine` validations from the probe objects in both projects. Without that, both projects failed identically on `state-machine-no-initial-states`, an author-time rule unrelated to `data:`. The probe projects were deleted.
- Measured, as the seat asked: no app the exporter emits on refresh is refused or deleted by the new refusals. The check pin "the exporter's own output … has no finding" runs the new check over this exporter's output. The exporter's new refusals cannot fire on the gallery's apps as far as in-repo evidence reaches. Every one of the 9 cards seeds only objects in its `expect.objects`, and the recorded `travel_expense` build declares all 7 seeded objects. That build artifact carries no `data`, and the probe's scaffold config shape takes the edit. For `asset_lifecycle`, 6973237961 added `data:` to the gallery source by hand, and 559 rows (the card's full count) inserted with 0 errors, so the source had no `data:` of its own. The gallery repository itself is not readable from this session, so its other listed apps were not checked directly. A tree written by the earlier exporter has no sample-data file, so the check reports each of its apps until the next refresh re-exports it. The check writes nothing.
- `order_to_cash`'s English title is 131 characters. `PackageSchema.displayName` allows at most 128, and its `objectstack.manifest.json` fails `TemplateManifestSchema` (measured). The exporter writes it anyway rather than refuse the app (a refusal would delete a listed app). This is reported to the seat as a decision; see the report.
- The scaffold's `objectstack.manifest.json` keeps `readmePath: 'README.md'`, but the exporter never copies the scaffold README into `source/`. `os package publish` reads `readmePath` and exits 1 when the file is missing (`publish.ts:883`, read, not run). carrier: #35134.
- `manifest.name` in the config (the in-app package name, e.g. `Demoasset`) is unchanged: the listing name is `objectstack.manifest.json` `displayName`. carrier: #35134.
- Sample rows carry the card's own dates (its `asOf`), not the run date's rebase.
- Public surface of `@objectstack/scenarios/export`: new exports `sampleDataOf`, `listingManifest`, `withSampleData`, `trialPackageSource`, `TrialPackageRefusal`, `SAMPLE_DATA_FILE`, `SAMPLE_DATA_SPECIFIER`, `SAMPLE_DATA_BINDING` and the type `SampleDataset`. `FINDING_CODES` gains `app-sample-data`, so the check accepts less. There is one new runtime dependency, `typescript`.

## Verification

<details><summary>Gates (local subset, head 30a918ccf0)</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 75 families. All 75 ran: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 75 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 75 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero …)`.
- `pnpm check:cross-package-test-inputs` was red on a first draft, which read the blank scaffold config from `create-objectstack`. The pin now uses an inline scaffold-shaped fixture, and the gate exits 0 (`OK: 32 package(s) read outside themselves, all declared …`).
- `pnpm check:dts-closure` and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` both exited 1 once in the sweep, naming only `@objectstack/organizations`'s `dist/index.d.ts` (a package this diff does not touch) while its `dist/` was being rewritten. On re-run both exited 0: `260/260 declared declaration file(s) present`, and `124 published require entry point(s) … load`.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0, 0 anchored files.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` (origin/main, #35129 and #34223 merge cleanly).
- The repo-wide lint and the full CI battery are left to CI.

</details>
